Programmer Manual

Physics is in the Beam Physics Manual. This page lists entry points of the Julia package.

The object of the ring is the Lie product of Dragt–Finn factors. That is the same cut as MaryLie: concatenate in the algebra, analyse the product, track a point through it. Linear optics is the closed form of $\exp(:f_2:)$, stored as the matrix $R$. It is not a second theory of the lattice.

observables(lat) builds ring_lie_factor once and reads Twiss, $\eta$ and $\xi$ from that factor. ring_taylor_map is an RK4 polynomial and is not that object. ring_matrix remains a fast order-1 builder for plots along $s$.

Layout

pathrole
src/Constants.jlCODATA deuteron, reference particle, $v(\delta)$, $e(\delta)$, $z\leftrightarrow u$
src/Jets.jlpolynomial space, degree 4 in Hamiltonians, degree 3 in maps
src/Elements.jlelement types and lattice
src/Hamiltonians.jlelement generator $H$ as a polynomial
src/LieOperators.jlPoisson bracket, Lie series, Dragt–Finn, product of factors to degree 4
src/OptiMParser.jl.opt reader (mass from the particle, not the file header)
src/LinearOptics.jl$R=\exp(L S \mathrm{Hess}\,H)$, slice Twiss along $s$
src/Symplectic.jl$J^\mathsf{T}SJ-S$
src/Tracking.jlflow of each factor, thin RF kick, product of the ring
src/MapAnalysis.jlclosed orbit, $D_2$, $\eta$, chromaticity, observables
src/TaylorMap.jlindependent DA map (RK4 in polynomials) — a check
src/NormalForm.jlone-turn factor with thin RF; homological operator on generators; torus average of $\delta$
src/SecondOrder.jlaveraged longitudinal Hamiltonian, BLonD $(dt,dE)$ bridge
src/ExactIntegrator.jlunexpanded $H$, finite cavity, renormalise
src/Acceleration.jlramp, tune fit
src/Plotting.jlfigures
src/Optimizers.jloptional sextupole response

Entry: include("src/LieRing.jl"); using .LieRing.

The one-turn object used for the normal form is one_turn_factor_rf, the product of ring_lie_factor with the thin-kick factor. Optics of the magnetic product without RF is observables(lat). ring_taylor_map composes truncated polynomials and is not that object.

julia --project=. scripts/03_second_order.jl

julia --project=. scripts/05_rf_acceleration.jl

The equilibrium-momentum study lives in C:\GIT_REPOS\SCT_2\Julia\equilibrium_energy (scripts/run_v08.jl and the research note). It depends on this package via Pkg.develop.

Accepted design choices

  • Injection kinetic energy 10 MeV; final 270 MeV from the lattice header.
  • Stationary study: thin RF, $V=0.2$ MV, $h=5$, $\varphi_s=\pi$.
  • Ramp demo: finite cavity $L=1$ m, $\varphi_s=150^\circ$.
  • Mass = CODATA deuteron $1875.61294257$ MeV (OptiM Mass=2*938.272 ignored).
  • Lattice sequence used once (file Number of periods=2 is an error; bend is 360 deg).
  • Closed $D(0)=0.011$ m (OptiM initial 0 is not the closed solution).
  • Default sextupole strengths are zero.
